title: Design System: RemindMe
platform: Native Windows desktop, Qt6 Widgets. Tokens live in src/theme.cpp (ThemePalette) and are substituted into one app-wide Qt style sheet; snippets below are HTML/CSS approximations for preview only. pt sizes are converted at 96 DPI (1pt = 1.333px).

display.purpose: The next departure's countdown on the board (boardCountdown).

display-idle.purpose: Countdown slot with no upcoming reminder, in Board Slate (boardCountdownIdle).

headline.purpose: Reminder title in the due popup's board card (popupTitle).

headline-due.purpose: Due state in the popup body, Due Amber (popupDue).

title.purpose: Next reminder's title on the board (boardTitle).

cell-title.purpose: Timetable reminder titles and countdowns (cellTitle, cellCountdown; cellDue at 700).

cell-figure.purpose: Departure time in the Time column (cellTime).

hint.purpose: Input preview, errors, board greeting and meta (hint, error, boardMuted).

label.purpose: Column headers and section headings via makeCapsLabel(); uppercase.

overlay-figure-next.purpose: Next row countdown in the overlay, amber.

motion.name: completed-slide
motion.purpose: Recently done preview collapse/expand. The only animation in the system.

focus.name: focus-default
focus.purpose: Inputs, buttons, row actions; checkbox hover border.

qtMechanisms: Dynamic role property selectors, e.g. QLabel[role="cellDue"]; change at runtime with setRole() (unpolish + polish).
objectName selectors: QFrame#board, QFrame#popupBoard, QPushButton#primaryButton, QDialog#reminderPopup, QWidget#overlayWindow.
Placeholder colour set twice: QSS placeholder-text-color and QPalette::PlaceholderText.
Theme source: HKCU ...\Themes\Personalize AppsUseLightTheme; override REMINDME_THEME=light|dark.
knownGaps: Tabular figures are not set explicitly.
No DWM caption colour; the title bar stays system default.
No motion when a row becomes due.
Light QComboBox drop-down shows a platform-default edge.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Departures Board"**

RemindMe reads like a station timetable. A deep navy board band carries the next departure: its title, its when/repeat line, and an amber countdown that is the biggest thing on screen. Below it, the rest of the reminders wait in a plain white (or ink) timetable with fixed columns for Time, Reminder, Repeats and Due in, separated by hairline rules. The same board material reappears twice, and only twice: as the always-on-top overlay panel and as the head of the due popup.

The world is calm at rest and loud only at the moment of departure. Density is moderate, set by a fixed column grid rather than by cards. Everything is flat: depth comes from the one navy mass against a cool light ground (or a near-black blue ground in dark mode), never from shadows. Typography is Segoe UI throughout, so the app sits natively on Windows; hierarchy is carried by size and weight alone.

This is a native Qt6 Widgets app, not a web page. Every token below lives in `src/theme.cpp` as a `ThemePalette` field (declared in `include/remindme/theme.hpp`) and is substituted into one app-wide Qt style sheet through `@token` placeholders. Widgets opt into a style through a dynamic `role` property (`QLabel[role="cellDue"]`) or an `objectName` (`QFrame#board`, `QPushButton#primaryButton`). The palette follows the Windows `AppsUseLightTheme` registry value, with `REMINDME_THEME=light|dark` as an override.
keyCharacteristics: One navy board band per surface, carrying the next reminder.
Amber marks the next countdown and "Due now", nothing else.
Timetable rows on 1px hairline rules, with fixed-width columns.
Flat: no shadows anywhere; depth is tonal.
Segoe UI only; size and weight carry hierarchy.
Two complete palettes (light and dark) with identical roles.

rules.name: The Amber Departure Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on the next departure's countdown and on "Due now". With no upcoming reminder, the board countdown slot drops to `board-muted` at weight 300 (`boardCountdownIdle`). Ordinary countdowns in the table stay ink.

rules.name: The Two Ambers Rule
rules.body: Use `accent` on navy and `due-text` on the ground or table. Never put `accent` on a light surface; it fails contrast there.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: Each surface carries at most one navy board mass: the header band, the overlay panel, or the popup card. Navy is never used for table rows or ordinary cards.

rules.name: The Loudest Number Rule
rules.body: The next countdown is always the largest type on its surface. Nothing else on the board exceeds 19pt.

rules.name: The Column Header Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels name table columns or head a section's own list. They never sit above a larger heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Separate layers with tone and 1px lines, never with drop shadows.

dos: **Do** add every new colour as a `ThemePalette` field with a light and a dark value, plus a `@token` entry in `Theme::styleSheet()`. List longer token names before their prefixes (`@surfaceAlt` before `@surface`).
**Do** style new widgets through a `role` property or an `objectName` selector in the app style sheet, not through per-widget `setStyleSheet` colours.
**Do** keep Departure Amber for the next countdown and "Due now" only (The Amber Departure Rule).
**Do** build uppercase labels with `makeCapsLabel()` (8pt, 700, 108% spacing), and only for column headers or a section's own heading.
**Do** keep the timetable's fixed column widths shared between the header row and the data rows, so the columns line up.
**Do** use 1px borders and hairline rules for separation, with 6px corners on controls.
**Do** keep transparent 1px borders on borderless buttons so focus and hover do not shift the layout.
donts: **Don't** put `accent` amber on a light surface; use `due-text` there (The Two Ambers Rule).
**Don't** add drop shadows or gradients; the system is flat (The Flat Board Rule).
**Don't** add a second navy mass to a surface that already has a board, or use navy for rows and cards.
**Don't** set a type size on a surface larger than its countdown (The Loudest Number Rule).
**Don't** put an uppercase tracked kicker or eyebrow above a title. The unused `boardLabel` role in `theme.cpp` is not part of the system.
**Don't** use a second filled primary button on one surface.
**Don't** introduce another font family; Segoe UI Variable Text with Segoe UI fallback is the only face.
